blocks.x: Cyber & Zero-Trust applied to Maritime, Ports & Shipping. This page sets out the operating context, the delivery pattern we run, the services and platforms involved, and the outcomes we commit to.

Ports and carriers orchestrate billion-dollar physics: berth planning, crane productivity, vessel scheduling and cargo integrity. Telemetry-to-decision loops (berth windows, yard flows, maintenance) decide throughput on the same infrastructure — pure intelligence arbitrage.

items: Maersk-class ransomware memory; OT/corporate segmentation thin.
Vessel schedules vs. Yard reality disconnected; anchorage waits cost.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Cyber Resilience & Incident Recovery, Cyber Resilience & Incident Recovery, Identity & Access Modernization from the Cybersecurity & Zero-Trust tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Berth/vessel planning, Yard/gate orchestration, Crane/equipment maintenance) on Dataq Sentinel and Dataq Compass. Governance inherits the sector frame — SOLAS/ISPS among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Secure at the control plane: posture, workload and data security engineered into the platform.
Secure the models themselves: prompt-injection defense, agent containment and AI red-teaming.
Assume breach, plan recovery: resilience engineered, rehearsed and measured.
IT/OT segmentation and recovery drills (restart proven)

blocks.x: At industry level, the same pattern

At Logistics & Supply Chain level this capability reads as: carrier identity verification and double-brokering detection analytics (fraud losses down measurably). The sub-industry page narrows it to the unit's workflows, regimes and KPIs.

The engagement cadence below is the standard pattern for this capability. Weeks 1–2 lock the baseline: the current metric is measured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 deliver the pilot on bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses its gate is stopped or redirected with a documented decision, not quietly extended.
